item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello, and welcome! Welcome to your weather report for Wednesday, October 28. It's Wednesday, right in the middle of the week. Here in Shanghai, the day will be dull and cloudy. The warmest part of the day will be 20 degrees, and the coolest 12. Nice and comfortable today, not too hot and not too cold. Rain is very unlikely today. The sun goes down at 5:09 this evening, about 2 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? Look up at the clouds today. Can you find one shaped like an animal? Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be damp with light drizzle, reaching 23 degrees. This week is all about trying something hard. What is your favourite part? And that's the weather. Have a brilliant day!
